reason: We have decided to go into the new market and my network does not reach there, so I need a pipeline. A free list of 15 companies and three free meetings before I pay anything is cheap enough to try, but I would start the pilot carefully and watch every message.
objection: Our name is the business. If some agency spams buyers in a new country from domains connected to us, or we get a GDPR complaint, that costs me more than any meeting brings. One logistics client with 45 meetings is not much proof for a wholesaler like me.
would_change_my_mind: If the first messages read like generic spam, or they cannot show me who is legally responsible for the data, I walk away before the pilot starts.
